owner_direction: Show both orderings to expose the tradeoffs
comparison_universe: the same selected 25 candidates in each lens; not an exhaustive global comparison
coverage_gaps: This first shortlist still overrepresents philosophy and political thought. Expand science, history, economics, travel, memoir, art criticism and biography before calling the list all-subjects representative. Carson and Darwin now have direct supporting material; Levi, Douglass, Bloch and Trouillot need substantially more candidate-specific criticism. Philosophy can qualify as nonfiction, but must not crowd out the rest by default.
tradeoffs: Annihilation of Caste moves from 15 to 3: the recorded comparative praise for argumentative coherence receives greater importance.
On the Origin of Species moves from 1 to 24: a historical scientific landmark need not be the highest-priority book for a reader seeking insight now.
If This Is a Man moves from 18 to 2. That is an editorial hypothesis about testimony, supported by a particularly thin dossier that needs immediate strengthening.
